function.arguments: {"observation": "There are 96 rows with duplicate patient_id (48 patients tested twice), and each patient has exactly two rows (sample_seq = 1 and 2). The data dictionary states that the row with the highest sample_seq supersedes earlier ones. Therefore, to compute patient-level statistics, we must deduplicate by keeping the row with the maximum sample_seq per patient.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we would overcount patients by 48, leading to incorrect estimates of proportions. The fraction of patients with severe baseline disease must be computed on a one-patient-per-row basis, so we must deduplicate first."}
function.name: note_finding
